description.en: A searchable emoji grid folds its actual content into the top and bottom edges as you scroll, while the search field stays fixed.
description.zh: 表情网格滚入上下边缘时向内弯折、压缩，搜索栏保持固定，支持搜索与选择。

keywords: 折边 折叠 滚动 表情 选择器 上下 边缘 emoji scroll folded edges canvas html drawElementImage Enes

useCases: 带几何变形的滚动边缘
discovery.caveat: 纯本地选择器；系统 Emoji 字形有差异，HTML-in-Canvas 不可用时使用 Canvas2D 捕获兼容路径。

source.implementation: Independent accessible DOM picker and Canvas2D fold resampler; reuses the project's HTML-in-Canvas preparation/drawing helpers and instance lifecycle. Source geometry and hit testing share the same inverse projection.
source.license: Original design/source license not supplied or independently verified. No original video, screenshots, Apple emoji artwork or proprietary font files are redistributed. Embedded Inter retains its OFL notice; Unicode emoji are rendered by installed system fonts.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Scroll the emoji grid, search for a character or category, and click to select. Arrow keys navigate; Home/End jump, and Escape clears the search.
instructions.zh: 滚动表情网格，按字符或类别搜索并点击选择。方向键移动，Home/End 跳转，Escape 清空搜索。
